Exceptional Equestrian Property on C6.91 Acres
Currinah, Ballaghaderreen, Co. Roscommon F45 E402:

Presented in immaculate condition throughout, this attractive detached bungalow stands on C0.81 acres of beautifully maintained grounds and is offered for sale together with an additional C6.1 acres of quality land, making it an ideal opportunity for horse enthusiasts seeking a ready-made equestrian home.

The accommodation is bright, spacious and well-appointed comprising:
•	Welcoming entrance hall with tiled and carpeted flooring. 
•	Fully fitted and tiled open-plan kitchen/dining/living room, complete with patio doors leading to the back of the property. 
•	Sitting room featuring a striking fireplace and solid wood flooring. 
•	Utility room with tiled flooring. 
•	Three generous bedrooms, including a master bedroom with en-suite. 
•	Fully tiled family bathroom fitted with a luxurious Jacuzzi bath. 

Additional features include:
•	PVC double-glazed windows throughout. 
•	Tarmacadam driveway. 
•	Well-maintained gardens surrounding the residence. 


Outstanding Equestrian Facilities
A standout feature of this property is its superb equestrian infrastructure, offering everything required for private use, training or competition preparation. 

The extensive facilities include:
•	Approximately 6.1 acres of adjoining land. 
•	Three stables and a tack room, opening onto a small paddock. 
•	An open shed with three divisions, providing excellent storage and versatility. 
•	A professionally designed arena with a sand and rubber surface, complete with floodlighting for year-round use. 
•	A cross-country course set within the lands, providing an exceptional training environment rarely found in residential offerings. 

Combining a turnkey family home with first-class equestrian amenities, this unique property presents an outstanding opportunity for those with a passion for horses, whether for leisure riding, training or competition.

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality of the residence and the exceptional range of equestrian facilities on offer.
